Definition: of Hebrew origin (H3485); Isachar (i.e. Jissaskar), a son of Jacob (figuratively, his descendant):--Issachar.
BiblicalUsage: Issachar is one of the twelve tribes sealed in John's vision. In Revelation 7:7 twelve thousand are sealed of the tribe of Issachar, standing in the list between Simeon and Levi.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sealing of Issachar is the promise kept to the last tribe: God counts his people by name, and not one tribe is left out.
